title: 19-inch rack cabinet
summary: your units, depth and weight, on the wall or the floor
description: A 19-inch rack cabinet sized from what goes in it: how many units, how deep the gear is and what it weighs, on a wall or on feet. Laser cut and folded from one sheet thickness, bolted together with clinch nuts, EIA-310 rails, a door on hinge pins with a quarter-turn lock.
process: Laser cutting and press-brake bending, clinch nuts pressed in, powder coating, bolted assembly

difficulty.rationale: Seven press-brake parts, a hinged door with a cam lock driven by its angle, coupled statics limits and process checks across bodies.

standards: EIA-310 / IEC 60297 dimensions via IBM, Rack installation specifications for racks not purchased from IBM, and Digital Loggers, Rack specifications (the standards themselves not read): 465.1 mm hole centres, 450 mm opening, 15.9/15.9/12.7 mm vertical pattern, 44.45 mm unit, 9.5 mm square holes
Panel 482.6 mm, panel height 44.45 n - 0.8 mm, via Wikipedia, 19-inch rack (0.794 mm there, uncited)
247TailorSteel bending guidelines: die width, leg length and inner radius for CRS, AlMg3 EN AW 5754 H111 and AISI 304
Minimum radii and K-factor: the sheet-metal-enclosure Jig's sources (secondary, not re-read here)
Fabcon, Sheet Metal DFM Guidelines: hole-to-bend distance at least 2.5 t + r
ISO 7379 shoulder screw M6, shoulder 8 mm: Ganter data sheet
Essentra L-handle quarter-turn cam lock: cut-out, cam lengths and offsets (data sheet)
PEM self-clinching nuts CLS-M6: hole and edge distance (product pages seen through search, bulletin not read)
ISO 273 medium clearance holes via a published table (Optimas)
Load model: IBM's 20 kg per rack unit; the plate bending limit at a wall fixing is the builder's judgement, unreviewed; EN 1993-1-3 pull-through for comparison (a reproduction, not the standard)
materials: Cold-rolled steel DC01, 1.5 or 2 mm, powder coated
M6 screws and self-clinching nuts (PEM CLS or SP), ISO 7379 M6 shoulder screws, quarter-turn cam lock, cage nuts, wall anchors (the buyer's), M10 levelling feet for the floor version
